metadata.title: Industrial Vinyl Record Cover with Safety Tape Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A centered metallic vinyl disc under crinkled plastic wrap, accented by high-contrast orange safety stickers and technical typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A top-down view of a silver, brushed-metal vinyl record encased in reflective, wrinkled shrink wrap. The composition is anchored by a large central circle and punctuated by vibrant orange rectangular stickers containing technical and display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular central subject against a square neutral background
High-contrast orange accents against a monochromatic silver/grey palette
Tactile plastic wrinkles overlaying smooth metallic surfaces
Rigid geometric stickers contrasting with organic plastic distortions
coreInvariants: Visible plastic shrink-wrap texture with highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The vinyl disc is centered and occupies approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central spindle hole and concentric grooves of the record.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central disc, move to the bright orange sticker in the bottom right, then follow the diagonal pull-tabs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform grey background surrounding the disc provides breathing room for the industrial elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey and silver metallic tones for the background and disc.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for typography and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant safety orange for stickers and pull-tabs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange elements against zero saturation in the metallic and background elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-condensed high-contrast serifs and utilitarian sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses extreme vertical elongation
Sticker text is strictly aligned to rectangular boundaries
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with neutral sans-serif for technical data.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif display style.
Matches the utilitarian sans-serif metadata style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down view of a silver metallic vinyl record on a grey textured background, covered in a layer of crinkled, reflective plastic shrink wrap with realistic highlights and shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large orange rectangle in the bottom right corner and two small orange diagonal tabs on the top-right and bottom-left edges. Place ultra-condensed serif text on the large rectangle and small sans-serif technical text on the tabs.

verificationChecks: Is the orange color vibrant and consistent?
Is the plastic wrap texture visible over the disc?
Is the display text vertically elongated?
Are the diagonal tabs placed at 45-degree angles?

mustRedesign: Transcribed lyrics or specific artist names
Specific 'Parental Advisory' logo (use generic warning text instead)

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp graphic edges on stickers

postGenerationChecks: Check that the disc is perfectly circular.
Ensure the orange stickers appear as overlays on top of the plastic.
Verify that the text is legible despite the condensation.
Confirm the background is a neutral, non-distracting grey.
recipe.reuseFormula: Metallic circular subject + plastic wrap overlay + safety orange geometric labels + condensed industrial typography.
